# Security Hunter Ledger

One line per entry, newest last. Statuses: `FIXED` (PR opened), `DOWNGRADED`
(real concern, not provable/fixable in a unit test — a human should look),
`NO-FINDING` (area swept, nothing cleared the bar).

- 2026-09-21 | FIXED | risk-model | BCP category-2/3 word-count limit counted a whitespace-free blob as "1 word", letting a reader agent smuggle unbounded data/instructions past the bandwidth cap | lib/tri_onyx/bcp/validator.ex
- 2026-09-21 | DOWNGRADED | risk-model | `TriOnyx.InformationClassifier.controlled_path?/1` checks `String.starts_with?(normalized, TriOnyx.Workspace.container_root())` without a trailing-separator boundary (unlike the correctly-guarded equivalents in workspace.ex:129, item_feedback.ex:365, session_logger.ex:207/222). No sibling directory literally prefixed "/workspace" exists in the current agent image, so it isn't exploitable today, but it's a latent inconsistency worth tightening to `<> "/"` defensively. More seriously, `controlled_path?/1` and `TriOnyx.Workspace.canonical_path/2` are purely lexical (string prefix matching on the tool's declared `file_path`) and never resolve symlinks against the real host tree — an agent that plants a symlink inside its own read-write `/workspace` pointing at `/github/<repo>` (mounted whenever `github_repo` is configured, and containing untrusted GitHub issue/PR text the TaintMatrix explicitly prices at `:high`) could have that content classified as `:low`/"controlled" when read back through the alias. Not provable in a pure unit test (the classifier takes no filesystem/agent context to resolve against), and the real fix needs the gateway to resolve the host-side real path before classifying, which is more than a small change — needs a human look.
- 2026-09-21 | NO-FINDING | risk-model | Reviewed `sanitizer.ex` (structural validation for inter-agent payloads — depth/width/string-length/key checks all correctly ordered; `sanitize_with_schema/2`'s `type_matches?(nil, _type) -> true` is a real schema-bypass-by-null but the `:schema` option of `TriOnyx.Triggers.InterAgent.route/2` has no caller anywhere in the codebase today, so it's unreachable), `taint_matrix.ex`, `sensitivity_matrix.ex`, `risk_scorer.ex` (matrix/modulation tables consistent with docs), `risk_manifest.ex` (git-trailer replay, review overlay — trailers are gateway-authored only, not agent-writable), `rate_limiter.ex`/`webhook_rate_limiter.ex` (fixed-window ETS counter; the non-atomic reset-then-insert on window rollover under concurrent load is a minor undercount race, not a meaningful bypass), and `bcp/query.ex` (`normalize_keys/1`'s `String.to_existing_atom` + rescue is fail-safe, not an atom-exhaustion vector).
